Founder | Acteble

Brussels, Belgium

Sole founder, architect and developer. Rust backend + Flutter mobile. The R&D layer also served as the dissertation for my MSc in Computer Science at UMons.

Flutter Dart Melos Riverpod Drift SQLite Dio gRPC FlutterMap Firebase OfflineFirst Mobile
